scene: Holding the glowing wafer, you spot three waiting exits outside.
picture: A flat side view of the aquarium exit bay. Far left, a brass steam train puffs smoke on tracks. Centre, the South Asian girl in her purple wheelchair and teal hoodie holds the glowing wafer. Up high, a red airship is moored to a tower. Far right, an idling yellow delivery truck waits.
shown: a brass steam train waiting on tracks at the far left
a tethered red airship floating beside a mast up high
a yellow boxy delivery truck idling at the far right
